therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: NK1 receptor antagonism (aprepitant); dopamine/serotonin receptor antagonism (olanzapine)
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients receiving high-dose melphalan conditioning for stem cell transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Complete Response (no emesis and no rescue anti-emetic therapy within 120 hours of melphalan administration)

results.effect_size: CR rates: Aprepitant 4/14 (28.6%), Olanzapine 11/21 (52.4%), Aprepitant plus Olanzapine 4/8 (50%)
safety_signals: Mucositis was the only reported serious adverse event across all arms

dose_info.dose: Aprepitant: 125 mg (Day -1), 80 mg (Days 0, +1); Olanzapine: 10 mg daily
dose_info.schedule: Aprepitant: Day -1 through Day +1; Olanzapine: Days -1, 0, +1, +2

context.indication: chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting with high-dose melphalan
context.comparator: each arm compared against the others (three-arm trial)

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Olanzapine's dopamine/serotonin receptor blockade may complement NK1 antagonism by aprepitant to broaden anti-emetic coverage across multiple receptor pathways, potentially amplifying overall CINV prevention.
modulation_entries.citation: Aprepitant Plus Olanzapine: 4 (CR count out of 8 patients, ~50%) vs Aprepitant alone: 4 (CR count out of 14 patients, ~28.6%)
